en: The page of an album contains two old black‑and‑white postcards mounted on brown paper with handwritten notes in German. The left postcard shows a narrow river or lake gorge between steep rocky, forested cliffs with a boat in the distance; it is labeled "Sortavala" and "Orjasaar(i)" with a handwritten message along the bottom. The right postcard shows a harbor scene with many boats moored in front of an ornate waterfront cityscape including prominent multi‑storey buildings and towers; it is labeled "Wiburg / Wiborg" with dense handwriting below. The album page headings mention Finland in German and are dated 'Februar – März 1902'.
